Each should feel visually distinct and contain exactly five named landmarks with stable proposed IDs suited to the existing landmark archetype matching. Keep the current roll/build/raid economy and unlock mechanics. Include provisional costs and explain how they need balancing against Neon; do not claim playtested balance. Preserve existing saves, contiguous district IDs and unlock order. Cover all theme routing/fallbacks, source-defined persistence limits, archive and travel behavior, building/repair rules, and the tests that currently assume three districts. Scope album parity explicitly: propose a four-card set per new island with art/manifest work, released only when complete. Name exact existing files and clearly label proposed new files. Include concrete acceptance tests and commands, 320px/mobile plus desktop/reload visual checks, and distinguish web checks from Android/device proof. Do not add sailing, weather, flight currencies, dependencies or new gameplay systems. Produce a concise but complete Markdown plan grounded in the supplied source citations, and flag missing evidence. Do not implement or run tools.
